name: Sika® Anchor-300

breadcrumb.name: PVC Sheet Membranes for Tunnels and Cross Passages

tagline: anchor fixation through sheet waterproofing membranes
summary: Sika® Anchor-300 is a hard PVC anchor shaft in grey colour combined with Sikaplan® PVC waterproofing membrane flange in yellow colour.
metaDescription: Sika® Anchor-300 is a hard PVC anchor shaft in grey colour combined with Sikaplan® PVC waterproofing membrane flange in yellow colour.
attributes: Allows watertight hot air welded seam with Sikaplan® WP membranes
Good force transfer through hard PVC shaft
Waterproofing line around anchor (no additional sealing elements required)
usage: Sika® Anchor-300 is used in double-shell tunnel constructions in combination with waterproofing sheet membranes on base of PVC-p to temporary fix the reinforcement of the inner lining to the outer shell, until the secondary concrete or shotcrete lining is cured and self-supporting.
advantages: Allows watertight hot air welded seam with Sikaplan® WP membranes
Good force transfer through hard PVC shaft
Waterproofing line around anchor (no additional sealing elements required)

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Watertightness test (Vacuum testing):
-0.2 MPa by Sika Testing System TM 87

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 5 years shelf life from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in dry conditions, protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc.

items.label: Diameter
items.text:
Shaft: Inside Thread M16, length 200 mm
Membrane: 300 mm
